envelope.description: Widen PolicyReader and await it at its readers

body.title: Widen PolicyReader and await it at its readers
body.summary: While the producers are still synchronous, widen PolicyReader to return a value or a Promise and add awaits at its seven production readers (gate.ts, signoff.ts, tracker-auto.ts, draft-issues.ts, daemon/repo-settings.ts and the two in gate.ts). Audit the callers of PolicyReader for use of opts.signal and record whether it stays. Awaiting a plain value is harmless, so the tree stays green.
acceptanceChecks: tsc is clean and the existing tests of the touched modules pass unchanged
the audit of opts.signal is written in the commit message and the type keeps or drops it accordingly

tests.name: no-floating-promises.test.ts: the PolicyReader readers await the widened return
